golden_qa.jsonl.purpose: Regression QA prompts and expected answers for product and pricing checks.
golden_qa.jsonl.provenance: Curated internal evaluation set kept in Git for deterministic regression testing.

system_prompts.json.purpose: Shared system prompt catalog referenced by compact training, validation, and test JSONL records.
system_prompts.json.provenance: Extracted from repeated ChatML system blocks in the 2026-04-30 train/test/val splits.

train.jsonl.purpose: Primary compact training corpus for general ApexMail assistant behavior.
train.jsonl.provenance: Maintained in-repo from reviewed product and documentation examples.

train_agent.jsonl.purpose: Task-oriented agent training data for ApexMail-specific workflows.
train_agent.jsonl.provenance: Derived from curated internal workflow examples and reviewed prompts.

val.jsonl.purpose: Compact validation set for tuning and regression checks during training iterations.
val.jsonl.provenance: Maintained alongside the training corpus to track behavior changes over time.

test.jsonl.purpose: Compact holdout evaluation set for post-training quality checks.
test.jsonl.provenance: Reserved in-repo evaluation dataset kept separate from training inputs.

recovered_training.jsonl.purpose: Recovered historical examples retained for auditability and selective backfill.
recovered_training.jsonl.provenance: Recovered legacy training data retained until every record is either re-curated or retired.
